Name: Vanilla friendly Penny portrait
Author: priority02
Description:
Hello? This is the vanilla friendly Penny portrait mod. I pressed Penny's face vertically, so it looks younger and cuter, I think. It only changed every portrait image of Penny, no other game data. You don't have to worry that this mod only contains one person, Penny. Because it is vanilla friendly. It will look natural with other townies.


Installation : 
Put Penny.xnb file to 

\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits

And override it. (Backup the original files in case...)

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
